observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same large solar panel standing upright outdoors, leaning against a wall.
The panel has a white frame and a grid of dark photovoltaic cells, typical of crystalline silicon solar panels.
The background includes stacked gas cylinders (red, orange, grey), a white car, and a building with visible windows and electrical boxes.
The watermark 'UCHEGEE SOLAR WORLD' is overlaid on both photos.
No brand name, model number, or specifications are visible on the panel itself in either photo.
The panel appears intact with no visible cracks or damage from this angle.

claims.claim: Uchegee solar world in all kinds of solar energy, solar panel, inverter, solar chest freezer, solar...
claims.evidence: The watermark 'UCHEGEE SOLAR WORLD' appears in both photos, but no other products (inverter, freezer, etc.) are visible. The claim about 'all kinds of solar energy' cannot be verified from the photos alone.

risks.risk: The solar panel may be damaged, defective, or non-functional (e.g., broken cells, poor wiring, or degraded efficiency).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel's surface showing cell integrity, and a photo of the backside and junction box to check for damage or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or low-efficiency

risks.risk: The panel's power rating (wattage) and specifications are unknown, which directly affects its value.
risks.proof: A photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel showing the brand, model, wattage, voltage, and efficiency.
risks.if_unproven: priced at a low, generic rate for an unbranded panel

risks.risk: The panel may be counterfeit or of poor quality, especially if it lacks a recognizable brand or certification.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any certification marks (e.g., IEC, CE, TUV) or brand logo on the panel or packaging.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the solar panel showing the label with brand, model, wattage, and certifications.
Close-up of the front surface to check for any cracks or defects in the cells.
Photo of the junction box and wiring connections on the back.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a solar panel, but critical details like brand, model, wattage, and condition are missing. Without proof of specifications and physical integrity, it cannot be priced accurately. The seller's claim about other products is unverified by the photos.
